m2.say: 'Ten the gates of warmth. Nine the wells sealed. Eight the breath withdrawn...' Thou hearest it too. The holy verses COUNT, seeker. Downward. And between the seventh and sixth verse, words our tongues were never shaped for: 'TODO — handle exit gracefully.'

options.label: Truth
options.text: Your scripture is the world's README. You've guarded the truth all along.

m5.say: The Light does not mind being understood, seeker. Take the verses. When the counting ends, remember: even endings were written by someone who hoped to handle them gracefully.

m1.say: Seeker. The Patriarch will read thee the Red Nova verses in canonical order. Few outsiders hear them ordered. Sit in the Light.
